subject: MAP: POC activation & network handoff — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP kickoff — POC activation & network handoff

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) that outlines the POC milestones we recommend to complete validation in a 3-week cadence. To start the environment activation we need the following items from your side: 

- Org setup: a service account and a minimal org identifier (we'll use for RBAC)
- API keys: we will provision a scoped key for the evaluation; please confirm who should receive it
- IP allowlist: comma-separated list of egress IPs that must be allowed for our hosted test instances
- VPC peering: point of contact for peering + desired CIDR ranges

Can you confirm owners and an ETA for those items? If it helps, we can run a short 30-minute handoff call tomorrow to collect the details and generate the initial credentials.

I've attached the MAP draft (map_v1.pdf) and a template (ip_allowlist.csv) you can fill in.

Next steps proposed:
1) Fill ip_allowlist.csv and return to us (NetOps)
2) Provide service account/email for org setup
3) Sign vpc_peering_agreement.pdf and share with your cloud team

Thanks — happy to adjust the sequence to match your compliance needs.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191

Hi all,

Thanks for confirming the slot tomorrow. Quick technical notes and a minimal checklist you can hand to NetOps during the call: 

1) Org setup & service account
- Please share the service account email that will own the evaluation tokens. We will create a scoped API key bound to that identity and to the evaluation project.

2) API keys & scopes
- We issue short-lived evaluation keys for POCs. Procurement: attached is the scope document (map_v1.pdf) and a short API terms doc. Once procurement signs off, we generate the trial key and send it to the service account email.

3) IP allowlist
- We require egress IPs to be allowed for the hosted test endpoints. Use ip_allowlist.csv (attached) — include CIDR or single-IP per row and a short description column.

4) VPC peering
- For cloud-to-cloud peering please confirm: provider (GCP/AWS), your VPC CIDR, desired region, and a point-of-contact email for route exchanges. We'll supply our side CIDRs in the call and the vpc_peering_agreement.pdf to formalize.

5) Rollback & data controls
- For this POC we recommend timeboxed logs with RBAC limited to the service account. If you require audit logging or a private deployment evaluation we can scope that in a followup.

Attachments included: ip_allowlist.csv (template), vpc_peering_agreement.pdf (template), map_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones).

See you tomorrow 16:00 ET. I'll share a dial-in + short runbook prior to the call.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
